title: Mythic Clan League (MCL) — Season 1
tagline: The first top-tier clan team-game tournament in Age of Mythology: Retold.
body: The Mythic Clan League (MCL) is a premier 3v3 tournament for Age of Mythology: Retold, created to showcase the highest level of competitive team-game strategy. It brings together top clans and rising contenders in a structured, high-stakes competition.

Unlike the 1v1 format, which tests individual skill, the team-game setting rewards adaptability, synergy and perfectly coordinated strategy. Every decision echoes across three armies — the depth that makes the AoM team-game scene such a compelling RTS experience.

title: Monthly DoD FFA — March 2026
tagline: A fun community free-for-all that everyone can join.
body: DoD hosts the monthly FFA again. This edition introduces a new game mode by [DoD]Skray: Vassal.

In Vassal, killing a player's Lord Theocrat doesn't knock them out as in Regicide. They become your vassal and join your team, and all their town centres but one convert to you. When their resources pass a threshold, they're taxed and the tax goes to you.
The game ends with one Overlord and everyone else as vassals. Even with every player still alive, only the Overlord gets the victory screen.

details.label: Maps
items: River's Eye (King of the Hill) — random map script by [DoD]Cod1eh
Vassal — The Unknown with Vassal rules on top, by [DoD]Skray

details.label: Format
items: Two groups if numbers allow, otherwise one
If enough players remain: Game 3, River's Eye with Vassal rules

details.label: Sign-up
items: Post your in-game name in the Discord forum post, or DM [DoD]mMoksha333
